decisions.reason: White-label test pressings are limited-run collector items that cost little to list on an existing catalog platform, so with demand still uncertain after only one year the option is cheap to keep open, although small batch runs may simply sell out and lapse.

A compilation series close to the core offer and in-house label carries almost no holding cost in a mail-order catalog, and its value is not yet revealed after one year, so keeping the option open is the rational choice.
